definitions: Terrain densities count full map tiles. Resource/group counts refer to authored half. Low-degree fraction counts open tiles with at most 2 open 8-neighbours: an observable corridor proxy, not a proof of chokepoints. Spawn separation is the Chebyshev distance between mirrored spawn-area centres, not actual travel time. Bush components use the bot labeller's 8-connectivity. Static-open components exclude walls/holes, not camps, abilities or dynamic units; they are a terrain-connectivity proxy. No outcomes used to choose thresholds; the bush component descriptor was added after the static partial-label finding, before any K006/fresh scores.
cutoff_rule: Official ladder medians, fixed before robustness/holdout results; >= cutoff is upper group. Do not tune subgroup boundaries to winners.
